name: Bauernhoferlebnis auf der Greissl Alm
beschreibung:
=== description ===
A day at the **Greissl Alm** lets families experience authentic Tyrolean farm life. Kids can pet cows, feed goats, and watch cheese-making in action. The farm owner shares fascinating tales from daily alpine life, while adults enjoy a hearty *Brettljasn* (a traditional Tyrolean spread) and homemade cider.
